text:
lucy: I'm thinking about making queueing explicit: input -> holding -> execute. Holding is a short-lived staging queue that owns admission/eviction logic. Makes backpressure boundaries testable. Thoughts?
sam: +1. explicit staging makes it easier to reason about admission credits and headroom.
maria: Big question: who owns KV cache pointers while a req sits in holding? If we don't pin ownership we leak TTL semantics.
raj: Proposal: Enqueue returns a Lease object with lifecycle ops: lease.acquire, lease.commit, lease.revoke. Lease includes flags: preemptible, fastpath_hint, signature. Example: {"id":"L-42","weight":12,"preemptible":true,"fastpath":false,"exp":1678899999}
lucy: we should also expose a Revoke(lease_id, reason) RPC so scheduler can forcibly reclaim. Reason should be a short string for telemetry.
sam: telemetry mapping: map existing batcher_queued -> input_enqueued, add holding_wait_ms_p50/p95 and execute_latency_ms_p50/p99 so alerts keep working. Add a translation shim during rollout.
maria: ordering: evict+retry risks reordering. dispatch must dedupe by sequence_id for ~1500ms. Keep dedupe window configurable.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy started by @raj - canary=batcher-refactor-v2-2026-03-22
raj: operator knobs I want: headroom_pct, eviction_hysteresis_ms, max_holding_ms, fastpath_token_threshold. My suggested defaults: headroom_pct=25, eviction_hysteresis_ms=75, max_holding_ms=200, fastpath_threshold=6
lucy: migration plan: adapter that presents old Enqueue API but implements new holding stage when flag batcher_v2=true. Rollout per-shard, disable on regression.
sam: tokens: signing tradeoff? signing prevents client spoofing priorities but adds CPU. Make signing optional and HMAC-based with rotating keys.
maria: warmup: holding should accumulate a tiny length_histogram and surface a model_warm_hint to execute so kernels can pre-select fast paths.
lucy: I'll add commit semantics: commit(lease_id) means dispatch can safely mutate KV cache; before commit the holding queue owns weak refs.
raj: agree. make commit idempotent. Also include a small "evict_reason" enum in telemetry: ["headroom","hysteresis","preempt","ttl","manual"]
sam: please include an emulation harness that can replay traces, simulate eviction storms, and verify dedupe + kv-cache hit rates.
maria: who will own the short-lived KV pointers in holding? Holding should keep pointers & touch counts; dispatch copies on commit. That avoids double-free races.
lucy: timeline: prototype shim this week, proto + harness EOW, RFC follow-up next Tue, canary next sprint. I'll open PRs.
raj: I'll draft the RFC follow-up with sequence diagrams and a migration checklist. Tagging @sam and @maria for review.
lucy: thanks all. small next step: i'll push a tiny PoC of lease lifecycle API and the holding queue adapter.
